original_test_intent: Run the approved HGX NVQual Test #2 and prove each configured link-up cycle produces the complete expected NVIDIA PCIe device inventory at approved link state without unplanned hang, reboot, reset, or new platform error.
original_method: Bind the NVQual revision/configuration, HGX GPU/root-port/switch/retimer hierarchy, expected BDF/device/serial/UUID set, generation/width, iteration count, and any reset or power boundary; preserve baseline logs; for each iteration durably record control action, boot/settle timeline, complete topology/inventory/link state, NVQual result, and health/error deltas; stop on first missing/misbound device or instability and recover out of band.
manual_activity: HGX owner/FAE supplies and approves the proprietary Test #2 recipe and any reset/power boundary; an operator isolates the SUT, supervises power control and out-of-band recovery, and adjudicates the complete inventory evidence.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #2 package, license, configuration, firmware, and driver compatibility
Exact HGX GPU/root-port/switch/retimer/BDF/device-ID/serial/UUID topology and expected population
Iteration count, link generation/width, settle deadlines, tool pass fields, and permitted reset/power actions
Dedicated SUT, persistent storage, error-delta, abort, recovery, and final-state policy
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production HGX SUT with explicit tool and reset/power authorization
No unsaved workload and verified BMC/console/power recovery
Export/hash logs and inventories before the test instead of clearing evidence
Stop on wrong topology, missing/extra/misbound device, downtraining, hang, unplanned reboot, new AER, GPU/host reset, thermal/power anomaly, tool fault, or evidence gap
No forced reset, repeated power cycle, inventory filtering, or blind retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate exact Test #2 manifest, topology, identity set, baseline, interlocks, and storage
Run only approved iterations and control boundaries
Commit complete topology/inventory/link/tool/error evidence for each iteration before another control action
Correlate host PCIe view, NVIDIA UUID inventory, NVQual, AER, OS, and BMC health
Do not infer iteration or power semantics, hide devices, retry faults, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve NVQual Test #2 recipe, HGX target topology, iterations, and reset/power boundary
Define exact expected devices, identities, link generation/width, settle time, tool fields, and error acceptance
Review all iteration evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The description matches link-up and NVIDIA enumeration but is not executable without the pinned Test #2 manifest and cannot establish identity-complete per-iteration coverage with a final lspci/nvidia-smi snapshot.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the owner-approved NVQual Test #2 recipe with an atomic iteration ledger that binds control action and boot/settle state to complete expected-versus-observed PCIe and NVIDIA identity sets, link state, and error deltas.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #2, link up, NVIDIA enumeration, all items, no hang/reboot, no bundle, and 5/15-minute estimates remain; unspecified iterations and control actions are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a signed expected-device topology and compare full BDF/device-ID/serial/UUID/link sets after every approved iteration and reset/power boundary, retaining raw NVQual and health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines identity-complete enumeration, link acceptance, persistent per-iteration evidence, control boundaries, first-fault handling, and recovery while preserving logs.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Counts or filtered outputs can miss duplicates, swapped/misbound GPUs, wrong BDF/UUID mapping, downtraining, transient disappearance, and earlier AER or reboot events.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A reset or power-cycle can remove all in-band control; a missing GPU may require physical or out-of-band recovery and must not be hidden by rerunning until enumeration returns.

project_override_considerations: If Test #2 has no reset or power action in the pinned vendor revision, retain a software-only iteration boundary and explicitly document that distinction; never add destructive actions solely because DeepSeek mentions them. Photos are supporting evidence, not a substitute for machine-readable identity sets.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash plus owner-approved NVQual Test #2 manifest and authorization
HGX/NVQual/firmware/driver/BMC identities and complete expected topology/BDF/device-ID/serial/UUID/link matrix
Baseline raw lspci/NVIDIA inventory/AER/OS/BMC evidence and reset/power/iteration contract
Per-iteration NVQual result, full expected-versus-observed device identities, link generation/width, timestamps, boot/settle and control-action history
First-fault recovery or clean final inventory/link/host state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, NVQual Test #2 Procedure, generic all-items Criteria, and same-row AI review consistently target link-up and NVIDIA enumeration. Missing iteration and control semantics are execution decisions rather than contradictory source identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The link-up/enumeration objective is clear. Proprietary package, exact Test #2 manifest, identity matrix, control scope, isolated hardware, and recovery gate execution without blocking static review.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2122 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00001-V002: approve the exact NVQual Test #2 package/configuration, HGX GPU/root-port/switch/retimer and BDF/device-ID/serial/UUID map, expected device set and link generation/width, iteration count, reset versus power-cycle semantics and settle deadlines, per-iteration completeness/error rules, first-fault interlocks, final state, and out-of-band recovery.

review_improvement: Converts generic device visibility into identity-complete, per-iteration link/enumeration evidence and prevents a recovered final snapshot from masking missing GPUs, downtraining, hangs, or earlier reset faults.
independent_technical_reasoning: Enumeration is a set-and-identity assertion, not a device count. Every expected GPU and upstream path must be matched by stable identifiers and negotiated link properties after each actual Test #2 boundary. A later retry can restore a temporarily missing device and erase the causal relation to reset, boot, or link training, while filtered output can hide extra or misbound devices. Therefore the complete raw identity set and error timeline must be committed before any next iteration or recovery action.
